label: itsu menu — per-product nutrition facts pages
notes: The /menu/ listing page (server-rendered Nuxt) yields 118 product URLs of the form /menu/<category>/<slug>/ and shows kcal only. Each product page carries a <dl class="nutrition-facts"> with dt/dd pairs: energy (kcal), fat (g), of which saturates (g), protein (g), carbohydrates (g), of which sugars (g), fibre (g), salt (g), plant points. All 118 products resolved to both kcal and protein.
